name: @r4-adapters/identity-verification
description: R4-J4 SEC-OTP channel identity verification (outside R4 Core). SEC-S1: the pure classifier of inbound text while a verification is pending: Unicode normalization, 4–8 digit candidates, redact(candidate) separated from submitForConfirmation(candidate), CODE_CONTEXT allowlist, neutralization of forged platform markers, fail-closed rule. No I/O, no network, no database, no secrets, no channel or provider names. Not wired to any ingress.
